diagnosticResult.title: Your result
diagnosticResult.subtitle: This is guidance based on your answers, not certified legal advice.
diagnosticResult.doraOutText: You didn't indicate being a regulated financial entity: DORA doesn't apply.
diagnosticResult.doraInText: As a regulated financial entity, DORA governs your ICT risk management.
diagnosticResult.overlapText: DORA takes precedence over NIS2 for regulated financial entities (lex specialis principle): DORA governs your ICT risk management, even though your sector also falls within NIS2's scope.

reasons.hors_ue: You indicated you don't operate in the EU: NIS2 doesn't apply to your organization.
reasons.secteur_non_couvert: Your industry isn't listed in Annexes I or II of the NIS2 directive.
reasons.trop_petit: Your headcount and financials place you below the NIS2 threshold (under 50 employees and under €10M turnover/balance sheet), with no qualitative exception.
reasons.annexe2: Your sector falls under Annex II of NIS2: you're classified as an important entity.
reasons.annexe1_grande: Your sector falls under Annex I and your size exceeds the large-enterprise threshold (250 employees, or over €50M turnover and €43M balance sheet): you're classified as an essential entity.
reasons.annexe1_moyenne: Your sector falls under Annex I and your size matches a medium-sized enterprise: you're classified as an important entity.
reasons.derogation_qualitative: Although your size is below the usual threshold, a qualitative criterion (sole provider or critical impact) may bring you into NIS2's scope — confirm with a specialized lawyer.

checklist.title: NIS2 compliance checklist

designate-security-officer.title: Appoint an information security officer
designate-security-officer.description: Name a person (internal or external) responsible for driving NIS2 compliance — a single point of contact for authorities and internally.

write-security-policy.title: Write an information security policy
write-security-policy.description: A document formalizing the security rules that apply to the organization (access, passwords, device use, etc.), approved by management.

risk-assessment.title: Carry out a risk assessment
risk-assessment.description: Identify critical systems, the main threats, and assess their potential impact on the business.

incident-response-procedure.title: Set up an incident detection and response procedure
incident-response-procedure.description: Define who does what in the event of a security incident: detection, triage, escalation, remediation.

notification-deadlines.title: Know the mandatory notification deadlines
notification-deadlines.description: Early warning within 24h, notification within 72h, final report within 1 month to the competent authority in case of a significant incident.

incident-log.title: Keep a log of security incidents
incident-log.description: A dated history of incidents encountered, actions taken, and lessons learned — also serves as audit evidence.

backups.title: Set up regular, tested backups
backups.description: Automatic backups of critical data, stored separately from the main system, with restores tested periodically.

disaster-recovery-plan.title: Write a disaster recovery plan (DRP)
disaster-recovery-plan.description: A documented procedure to restore critical systems after a major incident (outage, ransomware, disaster).

crisis-management-plan.title: Define a crisis management plan
crisis-management-plan.description: Who decides, who communicates, and with what backup means if the usual tools (email, phone) are unavailable.

supplier-inventory.title: List critical vendors and suppliers
supplier-inventory.description: A list of third parties with access to your systems or data (host, software vendor, IT subcontractor).

supplier-contract-clauses.title: Include security requirements in supplier contracts
supplier-contract-clauses.description: Minimum security clauses (incident notification, audit rights) in contracts with critical suppliers.

system-updates.title: Keep systems and software up to date
system-updates.description: A patching policy for security updates across workstations, servers, and software in use.

vulnerability-management.title: Manage known vulnerabilities
vulnerability-management.description: A process to identify and fix security flaws in exposed systems (vulnerability scanning, security watch).

security-audit.title: Periodically audit the security measures in place
security-audit.description: Regular (internal or external) review of how effective the implemented measures actually are.

security-awareness-training.title: Train staff in cybersecurity best practices
security-awareness-training.description: Regular awareness training (phishing, passwords, use of company equipment) for all staff, not just IT.

it-hygiene-rules.title: Define basic IT hygiene rules
it-hygiene-rules.description: Automatic workstation locking, no installing unauthorized software, management of admin rights.

encryption.title: Encrypt sensitive data at rest and in transit
encryption.description: Encryption of disks, backups, and exchanges (HTTPS, VPN) containing critical or personal data.

least-privilege.title: Apply the principle of least privilege
least-privilege.description: Each user only has access to the systems and data required for their role — access rights reviewed periodically.

asset-inventory.title: Keep an inventory of devices and active accounts
asset-inventory.description: An up-to-date list of workstations, servers, and user accounts, with systematic revocation when a staff member leaves.

offboarding-procedure.title: Security procedure for departures and arrivals
offboarding-procedure.description: Access disabled on an employee's last day, equipment returned, shared passwords changed.

mfa.title: Enable multi-factor authentication (MFA)
mfa.description: MFA on all critical access: email, VPN, admin accounts, cloud tools.

emergency-communications.title: Secure emergency communications
emergency-communications.description: Have a backup communication channel (outside the usual email/phone) in case the main tools are compromised.
